subject: Request: short extension + sandbox top-up due to integration freeze
messages:
From: Ethan Zhao <ethan.z@velocityshift.ai>
To: Diego Fernandez <diego_fernandez@redwood.ai>
Cc: Priya Reddy <priya@velocityshift.ai>
Date: 2027-06-26 09:12 -0700
Subject: Re: POC timeline / sandbox usage

Hi Diego,

Quick note from our engineering team — we hit an unexpected blocker with the connector shim when attempting to serialize the webhook batch. It’s a runtime edge in our staging environment and has frozen our integration sprint.

We were counting on the trial sandbox to validate the end-to-end flow this week. With the hang we won’t be able to complete the demo window on Friday. Can we get a short extension + a small sandbox top-up to keep the environment alive while we triage?

I attached a trimmed integration log and a small architecture diagram to help.

Apologies for the late ask — ETA on our fix is uncertain until the root cause is validated (likely 48–72 hours).

Thanks,
Ethan
Ethan Zhao
Lead Integrations Engineer, VelocityShift
attachments: integration-log.txt, arch-diagram.pdf
From: Diego Fernandez <diego_fernandez@redwood.ai>
To: Ethan Zhao <ethan.z@velocityshift.ai>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.ai>, Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.ai>
Date: 2027-06-26 10:03 -0700
Subject: Re: POC timeline / sandbox usage

Thanks for the heads up, Ethan — and good troubleshooting context.

Quick answers:
- We can shift the demo window; please propose two new time slots next week.
- I can escalate a small sandbox credit top-up and a 7-day trial extension to preserve your test state while you dig in.

Marissa/Ben — looping you in to approve credits and confirm any billing/limits implications. If we grant the top-up, do you want to attach a note to the HubSpot deal?

Diego
Diego Fernandez
Senior Account Executive, Redwood Inference
Redwood Inference | diego_fernandez@redwood.ai

On it — I reviewed the log quickly. This looks like a staging timeout we can accommodate. Approve a one-time sandbox top-up of 50k tokens and a 7-day extension.

Ben, please confirm and add a short "make-good" line to the deal notes: 50k token sandbox top-up granted due to integration blocker; extension through 2027-07-04.

Marissa Cole

Diego / team — hugely appreciate the quick turnaround and the top-up. I confirmed the token increment and new expiry.

We pushed a mitigation (small config change) and have a candidate patch ready for validation tomorrow. We’ll aim to reschedule the demo for Friday 6/30 or Monday 7/3 — I’ll propose exact times by EOD.

We’ll also upload the failing request sample to the HubSpot deal thread per Marissa’s ask so your SREs can reproduce locally if needed.

Thanks again — this keeps our momentum.
